about.metaDescription: The story, vision, mission and values behind DAR AL AQAR.
about.title: Redesigning How the Kingdom Searches for Property
about.intro: DAR AL AQAR is a Saudi property discovery platform, designed to make finding your next home or investment clear, calm and enjoyable.
about.story: Choosing a property is one of the biggest decisions a family makes, yet the search is often exhausting: duplicated ads, missing information and crowded pages. We set out to build an experience that respects people's time, presents what matters clearly, and pairs a sense of place with modern design.
about.vision: To be the clearest, most effortless way to discover property in Saudi Arabia.
about.mission: To connect seekers and owners through accurate information and a digital experience designed for the Saudi market.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.body: Straightforward information, visible prices and an uncluttered interface.

respect.title: Respect for time
respect.body: Every step on the platform is designed to shorten the path to you.

craft.title: Craft
craft.body: We care for design and content the way an architect cares for a building.
